INSERT INTO dbo.executions (execution_id, job_name, start_time, created_at)
VALUES (
    '@{pipeline().RunId}',
    'Load Sales',
    '@{utcnow()}',
    '@{utcnow()}'
);

-- Update executions table
UPDATE dbo.executions
SET end_time = '@{utcnow()}',
    result = 'Success'
WHERE execution_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}';

-- Merge to jobs table
MERGE dbo.jobs AS target
USING (SELECT 
    'Load Sales' AS job_name,
    '@{utcnow()}' AS last_start_time,
    '@{utcnow()}' AS last_end_time,
    'Success' AS last_result,
    NULL AS error_message,
    '@{utcnow()}' AS updated_at
) AS source
ON target.job_name = source.job_name
WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET
        last_start_time = source.last_start_time,
        last_end_time = source.last_end_time,
        last_result = source.last_result,
        error_message = source.error_message,
        updated_at = source.updated_at
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
    INSERT (job_name, last_start_time, last_end_time, last_result, error_message, updated_at)
    VALUES (source.job_name, source.last_start_time, source.last_end_time, source.last_result, source.error_message, source.updated_at);

-- Update executions table
UPDATE dbo.executions
SET end_time = '@{utcnow()}',
    result = 'Failed',
    error_message = '@{activity('Load Sales Data').error.message}'
WHERE execution_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}';

-- Merge to jobs table
MERGE dbo.jobs AS target
USING (SELECT 
    'Load Sales' AS job_name,
    '@{utcnow()}' AS last_start_time,
    '@{utcnow()}' AS last_end_time,
    'Failed' AS last_result,
    '@{activity('Load Sales Data').error.message}' AS error_message,
    '@{utcnow()}' AS updated_at
) AS source
ON target.job_name = source.job_name
WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET
        last_start_time = source.last_start_time,
        last_end_time = source.last_end_time,
        last_result = source.last_result,
        error_message = source.error_message,
        updated_at = source.updated_at
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
    INSERT (job_name, last_start_time, last_end_time, last_result, error_message, updated_at)
    VALUES (source.job_name, source.last_start_time, source.last_end_time, source.last_result, source.error_message, source.updated_at);
